scope: Native hostile constructor-59 output associated with blue power plants; producer selection, cross-tier applicability, cadence, contact class, damage, targeting, motion, and retirement.

supersession.superseded_claim: Every blue power-plant tier eventually emits constructor 59.
supersession.replacement: Only the type-7 blue tiers 1, 2, and 4 can select constructor 59. Blue tier 3 is type 6; it deterministically emits constructor 31 once and has no constructor-59 producer path.
basis: The pristine executable contains exactly two immediate constructor-59 selections, both inside 0x8005C744..0x8005C818.
The type-6 handler 0x8005C6F0..0x8005C744 computes constructor (extra>>12)+31 and sets one-shot latch 0x0008.
The accepted tier-3 capsule segment keeps type 6 alive for 720 movie frames, observes constructor 31 at frame 2102, and observes zero constructor-59 births.

tier_matrix.static_selection: constructor 31 exactly once; no RNG and no constructor-59 path
constructor 59 on the 1/4 RNG branch; forced constructor 59 after global power bit 0x20 is set; otherwise constructor 39

timing.qualification: Observed exactly in the accepted all-tier fixture. The handlers contain no local recurrence counter; animation/scheduler state owns these frame intervals.

motion.targeting: none; flag 0x08 is clear, so the homing/target-follow branch is not entered

damage.power_interception: Existing invincibility/bubble contact-damage gates remain authoritative.

retirement.timeout: active counter 200 decrements once per logic update; zero becomes -1 and is finalized in the second pool pass
retirement.terrain: flags bit 0 enables generic terrain/world contact; collision clears active early
retirement.player: action 8 sets active to 1 and state to 0x13; the next update retires the record after dealing damage
retirement.effect: If state remains -60, pickup_effect_dispatch negates it and spawns constructor 60 at final coordinates

radial_helper.behavior: Eight sibling-spawner calls parameterized around a 4096-angle circle; this is an impact/presentation burst, not player acquisition or steering.

bounded_residuals: Campaign-wide plant-model/presentation census for all applicable levels.
Exact GPU, sprite, SFX, and SPU ownership of the hostile object and its constructor-60 burst.
Natural player-hit positive control for constructor 59; the damage chain is instruction-exact but the retained fixture's five objects hit terrain.
An unobstructed natural timeout control for the 200-logic-update fallback; the counter and cleanup path are instruction-exact.
phase4_boundary.reopen_if: A pristine Interpreter recording demonstrates a tier-3 hostile output, or a MOD consumer needs exact presentation/audio ownership or a natural no-terrain timeout oracle.
